none: PAS NLM-F53086: Roman Coin: Dupondius of Faustina Senior from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Dupondius. Commemorative Posthumous Issue of Faustina Senior [?I] dates 138-161), issue of 141, mint of Rome. Obverse description: Female bust coiffed right. Obverse inscription: [DIVA AVGVS]TA FAVSTINA. Reverse description: Female figure, probably Providentia, standing left holding globe in right hand and sceptre in left. S C in field. Reverse inscription : AETER[NI]TAS. This coin was kindly identified by Cliff Reeves, citing Sear volume 2 no. 4635. Diameter: 26.6mm, Weight: 11.84gms, die axis: 11
